title: Flawed Beauty: the Problem with Toughened Glass

sentences.en: On 2nd August 1999, a particularly hot day in the town of Cirencester in the UK, a large pane of toughened glass in the roof of a shopping centre at Bishops Walk shattered without warning and fell from its frame.
sentences.zh: 1999年8月2日,联合王国Crampersster镇特别热的一天,Bishops Wake一家购物中心的屋顶上一大片坚固玻璃被粉碎,没有警告,从墙框上摔下来。

sentences.en: When fragments were analysed by experts at the giant glass manufacturer Pilkington, which had made the pane, they found that minute crystals of nickel sulphide trapped inside the glass had almost certainly caused the failure.
sentences.zh: 当专家在制造玻璃板的巨型玻璃制造商Pilkington分析碎片时,他们发现玻璃中被困的微小硫化镍晶体几乎肯定造成了故障。

sentences.en: When the interior finally solidifies and shrinks, it exerts a pull on the outer layer that leaves it in permanent compression and produces a tensile force inside the glass.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: As cracks propagate best in materials under tension, the compressive force on the surface must be overcome before the pane will break, making it more resistant to cracking.
sentences.zh: 随着裂缝在紧张材料中最畅销,在玻璃板破裂之前必须克服表面的压缩力,使其更耐裂缝。

sentences.en: The problem starts when glass contains nickel sulphide impurities.
sentences.zh: 当玻璃含有硫化镍杂质时,问题就开始。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Trace amounts of nickel and sulphur are usually present in the raw materials used to make glass, and nickel can also be introduced by fragments of nickel alloys falling into the molten glass.
sentences.zh: 用于制造玻璃的原材料中通常含有镍和硫的痕量,镍也可以通过掉入熔化玻璃中的镍合金碎片来引进。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构

sentences.zh: 随着玻璃加热这些原子反应形成微小的硫化镍晶体

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构

sentences.en: Just a tenth of a gram of nickel in the furnace can create up to 50,000 crystals.
sentences.zh: 熔炉中只有十分之一的镍能够产生多达5万个晶体

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: These crystals can exist in two forms: a dense form called the alpha phase, which is stable at high temperatures, and a less dense form called the beta phase, which is stable at room temperatures.
sentences.zh: 这些晶体可以以两种形式存在:一种叫做阿尔法级的密度形态,在高温下稳定;另一种叫做乙级的密度较弱形态,在室温下稳定。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The high temperatures used in the toughening process convert all the crystals to the dense, compact alpha form.
sentences.zh: 坚硬过程所使用的高温将所有晶体转换成密度、紧凑的阿尔法形态。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But the subsequent cooling is so rapid that the crystals don’t have time to change back to the beta phase.
